item.title: Securely share biotech data, but without all the setup hassle
item.summary: Hey HN, founder of Peony here. Most biotech founders today are still going through the whole loop of chatting with sales then onboarding into a legacy data room platform like that of Sharevault or Ideals, I am from bioengineering myself and find that extremely unbearable. So I decided to push Peony into the direction of a self-served, 20x faster & more affordable solution. Excited for all you biotech friends to try it out and see how you think about it! We've had the luck of serving some big names in the industry over the past 18 months since launch, and I think we are ready to take it to the next level! https://www.peony.ink/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49356808 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
